question: Where is the nearest museum located toward southwest from Bresnan Arena, Mankato, MN?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bresnan Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Mankato%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MN%' LIMIT 1 ) AS arena WHERE p.tourism = 'museum' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(arena.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5 ORDER BY ST_Distance(arena.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) LIMIT 1;
